Signal timing compared using bar index with signal_timing_tolerance_bars (default: 0)
Signal counts compared per signal type with signal_count_tolerance (default: 0)
pytest test file exists with @pytest.mark.layer_2_signals marker
Unit tests verify indicator, timing, and count comparisons
